```{r Packages}
library(haven)
library(MASS)     
library(dplyr)    
library(car)    
library(srvyr)
library(pscl) 
library(brant)
library(tidyr)
library(survey)
library(openxlsx)
library(psych)
```
```{r Import Data}
ChatBots_DATA <- read_sav("ChatBots_DATA.sav")
```

#Score Variables
```{r Recoded variables}
#Age
ChatBots_DATA$age <- 2026 - ChatBots_DATA$birthyr

#PHQ
ChatBots_DATA$PHQ9_total <- rowSums(
  ChatBots_DATA[, c(
    "Depression_1",
    "Depression_2",
    "Depression_3",
    "Depression_4",
    "Depression_5",
    "Depression_6",
    "Depression_7",
    "Depression_8",
    "Depression_9"
  )],
  na.rm = FALSE
)

ChatBots_DATA$PHQ9_cutoff <- ifelse(
ChatBots_DATA$PHQ9_total >= 10, 1, 0)

#GAD
ChatBots_DATA$GAD7_total <- rowSums(
  ChatBots_DATA[, c(
    "Anxiety_1",
    "Anxiety_2",
    "Anxiety_3",
    "Anxiety_4",
    "Anxiety_5",
    "Anxiety_6",
    "Anxiety_7"
  )],
  na.rm = FALSE
)

ChatBots_DATA$GAD7_cutoff <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$GAD7_total >= 8,1, 0
)

#Help-Seeking
ChatBots_DATA$Professional_help_yes <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Professional_help == 1,1,0)

ChatBots_DATA$Friend_yes <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Friend == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$Family_yes <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Family == 1, 1, 0)

# General AI Chatbot Use
ChatBots_DATA$Ai_ever_use_yes <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_ever_use == 1,1,0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_30day_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_frequency %in% c(2, 3, 4, 5, 6),1,0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_daily_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_frequency %in% c(5, 6),1,0)

# AI Platforms
ChatBots_DATA$ChatGPT <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_1 == 1, 1, 0)
ChatBots_DATA$Gemini <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_2 == 1, 1, 0)
ChatBots_DATA$Claude <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_3 == 1, 1, 0)
ChatBots_DATA$Copilot <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_4 == 1, 1, 0)
ChatBots_DATA$MetaAI <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_6 == 1, 1, 0)
ChatBots_DATA$Grok <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_7 == 1, 1, 0)
ChatBots_DATA$OtherAI <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_used_m_14 == 1, 1, 0)

# Lifetime AI Mental Health Support Use
ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support == 1, 1, 0
)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use[is.na(ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use)] <- 0

# Past 30-Day AI Mental Health Support Use
ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_30day_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_frequency %in% c(2,3,4,5,6),1,0)

# Daily AI Mental Health Support Use
ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_daily_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_frequency %in% c(5,6),1,0)

# Lifetime AI Substance-Use Support
ChatBots_DATA$AI_substance_lifetime_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_subst == 1, 1, 0
)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_substance_lifetime_use[is.na(ChatBots_DATA$AI_substance_lifetime_use)] <- 0

#Support Type
ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_advice <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_1 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_feelings <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_2 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_emotions_out <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_3 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_situation <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_4 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_plan <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_5 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_emotional_support <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_6 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_positive <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_7 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_sympathy <- ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_8 %in% c(2,3,4), 1, 0)

# Make not asked / skipped missing for this section because this is among AI MH support users
reason_vars <- c(
  "AI_reason_advice",
  "AI_reason_feelings",
  "AI_reason_emotions_out",
  "AI_reason_situation",
  "AI_reason_plan",
  "AI_reason_emotional_support",
  "AI_reason_positive",
  "AI_reason_sympathy")

ChatBots_DATA[ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use != 1, reason_vars] <- NA

# AI Support Functions
ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_available <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_1 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_less_judged <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_2 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_easier <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_3 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_comfortable <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_4 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_less_lonely <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_5 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_guidance <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_6 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_cheaper <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_7 == 1, 1, 0)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_function_other <-
  ifelse(ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_function_m_8 == 1, 1, 0)

#Daily Social Media use
ChatBots_DATA$Daily_SM_use <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_1 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_2 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_3 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_4 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_5 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_6 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_7 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_8 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_9 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_10 %in% c(4,5) |
  ChatBots_DATA$SM_Frequency_11 %in% c(4,5),
  1, 0
)
```
```{r Survey weighted object}
design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~weight,
  data = ChatBots_DATA
)

#Helper function
# Weighted %
w_pct <- function(var){
  svymean(as.formula(paste0("~", var)), design, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Weighted mean
w_mean <- function(var){
  svymean(as.formula(paste0("~", var)), design, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Weighted SD
w_sd <- function(var){
  sqrt(svyvar(as.formula(paste0("~", var)), design, na.rm = TRUE))
}
```

```{r Coping strategies - sensitivity analysis}
#0 = not at all/a little; 1 = medium/a lot

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_advice_med <- ifelse(
  ChatBots_DATA$Ai_support_type_1 %in% c(3, 4), 1, 0
)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_feelings_med <- ifelse(

)

ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_sympathy_med <- ifelse(

)

# Limit to respondents who reported lifetime AI mental health support use
reason_med_vars <- c(
  "AI_reason_advice_med",
  "AI_reason_feelings_med",
  "AI_reason_emotions_out_med",
  "AI_reason_situation_med",
  "AI_reason_plan_med",
  "AI_reason_emotional_support_med",
  "AI_reason_positive_med",
  "AI_reason_sympathy_med"
)

ChatBots_DATA[ChatBots_DATA$AI_MH_lifetime_use != 1, reason_med_vars] <- NA

# Rebuild survey design after recodes
design <- svydesign(
  ids = ~1,
  weights = ~weight,
  data = ChatBots_DATA
)

# Unweighted
freqdist::freqdist(ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_advice_med)
freqdist::freqdist(ChatBots_DATA$AI_reason_feelings_med)

100 * coef(svymean(~AI_reason_feelings_med, design, na.rm = TRUE))
100 * coef(svymean(~AI_reason_emotions_out_med, design, na.rm = TRUE))
```

#Table 4
```{r Lifetime mental health use}
#PHQ-9 cutoff
MH_PHQ9_lifetime <- svyglm(
  PHQ9_cutoff ~ AI_MH_lifetime_use +
    age +
    factor(gender4) +
    factor(race) +
    educ +
    Daily_SM_use,
  design = design,
  family = quasibinomial()
)

summary(MH_PHQ9_lifetime)

# Odds Ratio
exp(coef(MH_PHQ9_lifetime))

# 95% CI
exp(confint(MH_PHQ9_lifetime))

# GAD-7 cutoff
MH_GAD7_lifetime <- svyglm(
  GAD7_cutoff ~ AI_MH_lifetime_use +
    age +
    factor(gender4) +
    factor(race) +
    educ +
    Daily_SM_use,
  design = design,
  family = quasibinomial()
)

summary(MH_GAD7_lifetime)

# Odds Ratio
exp(coef(MH_GAD7_lifetime))

# 95% CI
exp(confint(MH_GAD7_lifetime))

# PHQ-9 total score
MH_PHQ9_total_lifetime <- svyglm(
  PHQ9_total ~ AI_MH_lifetime_use +
    age +
    factor(gender4) +
    factor(race) +
    educ +
    Daily_SM_use,
  design = design
)

summary(MH_PHQ9_total_lifetime)

# Beta
coef(MH_PHQ9_total_lifetime)

# 95% CI
confint(MH_PHQ9_total_lifetime)

# GAD-7 total score
MH_GAD7_total_lifetime <- svyglm(
  GAD7_total ~ AI_MH_lifetime_use +
    age +
    factor(gender4) +
    factor(race) +
    educ +
    Daily_SM_use,
  design = design
)

summary(MH_GAD7_total_lifetime)

coef(MH_GAD7_total_lifetime)

confint(MH_GAD7_total_lifetime)

```
